name: stops polling and navigates nothing for an organic install
fullName: deferred install — product share link stops polling and navigates nothing for an organic install
description:
Fresh-install (deferred) deep link scenarios.

These cover the one launch that cannot be re-run by hand on a device without
uninstalling first: the first open after a store install, where the deep link
arrives from cached install attribution rather than an inbound URL.

Each `launch()` uses jest.resetModules() to reset module-level state the way a
cold start does, while AsyncStorage contents survive — exactly like a real
app relaunch.
descriptionHtml:
Fresh-install (deferred) deep link scenarios.

These cover the one launch that cannot be re-run by hand on a device without
uninstalling first: the first open after a store install, where the deep link
arrives from cached install attribution rather than an inbound URL.

Each launch() uses jest.resetModules() to reset module-level state the way a
cold start does, while AsyncStorage contents survive — exactly like a real
app relaunch.
